root_cause: The locale SEO validator compared serialized HTML text and meta attribute values directly against semantic keyword/title values. Valid ampersands were serialized as &, creating false title and keyword mismatches in the exact Netlify build.
prevention: Decode standard HTML entities before semantic locale metadata equality checks.
Keep the SEO locale gate fail-closed on real metadata drift while avoiding serialization-only false positives.
Exercise locale metadata validation through canonical Brain SEO replay tests.
fix: Normalize title/meta entities in validate-locales.mjs before comparing them to the locale revenue map.
